The '''inter-office communications device''' was a technological device that made a loud buzzing sound when pressed.<ref name="Glove" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] use of the inter-office communications device, in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] met with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] at the [[Droid Repair Shop (Yavin 4)|Droid Repair Shop]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to prepare the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for an undercover [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|mission]]. Skywalker used his inter-office communications device to signal the [[Droid Modification Team]] that C-3PO was ready to be disguised.<ref name="Glove" />

==Behind the scenes==
The inter-office communications device appeared in the first installment of the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] junior novel series, ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]] and published in [[1992]].<ref name="Glove" />
